title: Casting to bounded blocks preserves length
statement: Fix a natural number $w$ and let $l$ be a finite list of pairs $(i, b)$ with $i \in \bbn$ and $b$ a Boolean, every first coordinate of which satisfies $i < w$. Recasting $l$ into a list of pairs in $\mathrm{Fin}\,w \times \{\text{true}, \text{false}\}$ — by reinterpreting each index $i$ as the element of $\mathrm{Fin}\,w$ it names, while leaving the Booleans untouched — yields a list of the same length as $l$.
hypotheses_covered: a finite list l of (natural, Boolean) pairs
every first coordinate of l is less than w
